text_block_list.text:

karaoke on

year.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I hereby announce the start of Project
"Curren
Chan's Cutie ♪ Derby"!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It seems Curren Chan is trying to
coordinate some
strange project.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Allow me to explain!
choice_data_list_en: What do you mean by that...?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Remember how I showed you all my
potential
rivals at the end of last year?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Now that she mentions it, she did tell me
about
all the runners who are both
popular on social
media and good
sprinters.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:

would be
kind of a waste.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: I wanna create the most hyped-up event in sprint—no—in racing history! I want everyone to agree that sprints are the best!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
That's where Project Cutie ♪ Derby
comes in! It
links social media and races
together!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Here's the pitch. "Battle of the
Influencers! Put
Your Likes on the Line
and Take On Curren
Chan!"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, likes. You know! On all the social
media
platforms, when you think
something is cool,
interesting, or funny
or whatever, you "like" it.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:

followers
on each platform will battle
with their likes!
Check the handout I
gave you for more details.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The rules are simple. We count the
number of
likes everyone gets on things
they post on their
accounts during the
race period.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The number of posts and the posts'
contents don't
matter. Anything
submitted before the postrace
video
goes up will be counted.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Then we'll count all of the likes that
come in on
all of the posts until ten o'
clock the next morning
and whoever has
the most overall will be the
winner.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
In other words, the one with the most
likes is the
one with the most eyes on
her... and therefore the
most beloved
runner!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:

also
determining who's number one. Two
birds with
one stone. Super easy to
understand, right? ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:

indeed make it

number one. However,
there's one thing
that bothers me...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:

know not
everyone has accounts on
every platform like I
do.

text_block_list.name: Monologue

plan!

cuteness, I can't let anyone

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan

cuteness!
